name: CONTRACTOR Site Facilities, Warehouse, Laydown Area & Utilities
description: Statutory welfare/site obligations and the stamp-duty rates printed for leases of factories, buildings, business premises and workspaces, plus utility application instruments. No contractor laydown/warehouse rental rate for Sabah was found.
aliases: CONTRACTOR Site Facilities, Warehouse, Laydown Area & Utilities

specifications.metric: Site office / warehouse / laydown area — lease duty rate, term up to 1 year
specifications.unit: RM per RM250 or part thereof of annual rent
specifications.basis: HASiL Guideline LHDN.AG.600-1/10/3, printed 30 June 2026, section A 2.2 item 49(a): rate RM1.00 for lease <=1 year; examples of immovable property include kilang (factory), bangunan (building), tapak/ruang perniagaan and ruang kerja (workspace).

specifications.metric: Site office / warehouse / laydown area — lease duty rate, term over 1 to 3 years
specifications.unit: RM per RM250 or part thereof of annual rent
specifications.basis: Same HASiL guideline, printed 30 June 2026, item 49(a): RM3.00 for >1-3 years.

specifications.metric: Site office / warehouse / laydown area — lease duty rate, term over 3 to 5 years
specifications.unit: RM per RM250 or part thereof of annual rent
specifications.basis: Same HASiL guideline, printed 30 June 2026, item 49(a): RM5.00 for >3-5 years.

specifications.metric: Site office / warehouse / laydown area — lease duty rate, term over 5 years
specifications.unit: RM per RM250 or part thereof of annual rent
specifications.basis: Same HASiL guideline, printed 30 June 2026, item 49(a): RM7.00 for >5 years.

specifications.metric: Site office / warehouse / laydown area — fixed stamp duty, electricity and water supply application forms
specifications.basis: Same HASiL guideline, printed 30 June 2026, section G (general stamping, fixed duty RM10): section 4.4 'Borang Permohonan Bekalan Elektrik / Application Form for Electricity Supply' and section 4.3 'Borang Permohonan Bekalan Air / Application for Water Supply'.

gaps.what: CONTRACTOR Site Facilities, Warehouse, Laydown Area & Utilities
gaps.why: No published rental rate, laydown-area cost, temporary-utilities tariff or contractor site-facilities price for a Sabah gas-plant project was found. Only statutory stamp-duty rates and welfare duties are printed in the sources read.
gaps.next_action: Source the bidder's site-facilities price build-up and actual utility connection charges; leave the line item unpriced until obtained.

notes: WBS/BOQ line item from research/alaska-geg-wbs/alaska_breakdown.txt (5/6/7 Construction indirect, commissioning, EPC indirect).
